calls.statement:
SELECT m.home_store_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS ids,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS current_ids,
 sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows,
 min(join_date), max(join_date), max(valid_from)
FROM dim_member m
WHERE home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) OR home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS rows_all, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS ids, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_rows,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS cur_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS ids_with_multi_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)) AS ids_without_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to='9999-12-31' AND NOT is_current) AS open_not_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to<>'9999-12-31') AS cur_not_open
FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cur) AS home_tampere_members,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM active)) AS home_tampere_active52w,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM active) AS all_active52w,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.city='Tampere' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364) AS shopped_tampere_store_52w,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND marketing_consent AND home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)) AS home_tampere_consent

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS loyalty_members_tampere
FROM dim_member m
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.is_current
  AND s.city = 'Tampere'
  AND s.store_id < 900
